custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 1.3 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Theme: click your avatar (the AS circle) at the top right; Light and Dark are at the bottom of its menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens with the Description box outlined in blue.

Step 2:

  • The Description box shows its label small at its top left and "Design check part" under it.

Step 3:

  • The Cost box turns blue with a small blue label; the Description box turns back to a grey outline and keeps its text.

Step 4:

  • The Cost box shows "$ 45" (a dollar sign before the amount).

Step 5:

  • The Sell Price box is now blue with a small blue label and a "$" in it; the Cost box is grey again and still shows its amount.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and no part is created.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S7-R1: “The New Inventory Part dialog has a Description field, followed by a Part Number field. Both are free text.”
  • S13-R4: “The fields appear in this order: Description, Part Number, Part Status (editing only), Vendor, Category, Manufacturer, Average Cost (editing) or Cost (creating), Sell Price, Core Charge, Inventory Tracking (the switch, then Min and Max), Tags, and Inventory (bin locations, then "Add Bin Location").”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
